definitions.yield_penalty_pct: 100 * (control_yield_kg_ha - cover_crop_yield_kg_ha) / control_yield_kg_ha; negative means a yield gain.
definitions.net_return_change_usd_ha: Cover-crop net return minus control net return; negative means a loss. No subsidy included.
definitions.regime: Analyst interpretation documented per record; normal is a broad non-severe scenario bin, including wet years. Null means unclassified. These are not verified USDM labels.
definitions.null: Not reported or not established by the cited source; never a zero.
definitions.selection: One specified treatment comparison per site-year, not a pooled mean of all cover crops; eastern no-cover controls are not necessarily a full western-style fallow phase.

benchmarks.aggregation: Published dry-year summary for spring triticale and triticale-legume mixtures; not an individual site-year.
Three cycles in two Colorado State University trials; fall-planted cover crops without forage revenue.

benchmarks.notes: No supporting Kansas trial source established; excluded from records.

gaps.issue: No sourced dryland cover-crop versus fallow grain-yield comparison established. Located corn/forage-sorghum evidence uses irrigation at Tribune; not inserted as dryland data.
The paired 48%/-176 USD/ha benchmark belongs to Colorado, not a K-State western Kansas trial. The -172 USD/ha target remains unverified.
Site-year economic returns and plot areas are null except where explicitly reported; no invented costs, rainfall, or yields.
